purpose: Audit the explicit appearance branches in the company platform scope against the current catalog. The user requirement is at least four distinct, replaceable appearances per category and sub-branch. A recolor, version label, duplicate instance, or incompatible footprint is not a countable appearance.
countingRules: Count a resource only when it is a distinct geometry or construction that can replace another resource while preserving the branch function contract.
Do not count repeated instances, template copies, color-only changes, or the same generator output under another version label.
A resource with a changed footprint or changed use-point contract is a separate functional specification, not a replacement for the reference specification.
A child mesh inside a compound resource is not an independently replaceable appearance unless it has its own catalog identity, source, and replacement path.

Layout and use-purpose branches are recorded because the scope documents name them, but they are not silently converted into appearance assets. Their appearance count is null until a resource branch is explicitly defined.

summary.interpretation: The inspected implementation has five branches at four eligible appearances: plant, hanging-picture, desk, keyboard, and desk-microphone via the current static collection. Double sofa is the closest remaining branch at two compatible models. Most other current records are one procedural graybox or one compound template. Functional layout mechanisms, inline materials, viewing cameras, and lamp/stand child subparts are explicitly excluded from an independent four-asset quota.
